subject: science
concept: Understanding that Earth's tilt, not distance from the sun, causes the seasons
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Place in the Universe) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tilts a model Earth while orbiting a light source and observes how sunlight hits different areas differently across the orbit
exercise.pictorial: Student matches Earth's tilted position to the correct season for a marked hemisphere
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why seasons happen

misconception_flags: believes seasons are caused by Earth being closer to or farther from the sun

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
